:::{#def-new-observation}
#### New observation

A **new observation** is a pair $(\newpredvar, \newoutvar)$
of a covariate value and an outcome
drawn from the same population as the observations of a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$,
independently of $\trainset$.
The subscript $*$ marks a quantity of the new observation,
as in $\newpredvar$ and $\newoutvar$,
and distinguishes it from the indexed observations $(\vpredvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})$ of $\trainset$.

:::
